page.layout: One page of text, with a large woodcut of a crab (chela astaci) occupying the upper part; running title and heading at the top, text in full lines below the woodcut. No margin notes.; Running head at top left and page number at top right; below, a large woodcut illustration of a sea monster occupying the left and centre; beneath it one caption line of text running across the lower part; below the caption a second woodcut of a crustacean (lobster-like figure) with no text.

main_text.head: De Cru[...] CHELA ASTA[...]

p.i: [Woodcut of a crab claw, not transcribed as text.]

main_text.p: IN EADEM tabula Magnus depingit Astacum simili rhinoceroti; cuius rei typum requires sup[...]
ASTACVS paruus marinus, sui generis. Semper enim paruus est, nec unquam fe re magnitudinē picturæ nostræ superat, Rondeletius.
GERMAN. F. Ein kleiner Humer/ ein kleiner Meerkrebs.
LEO Rondeletij. Plinius Leonem nominat tantùm inter Cancrorum genera cum Carabis, Astacis, Mæis, &c. Diphilus A[...] n xii. pedum, qui devoratur à monstro marino inter Cete ex Tabula Olai.

page.notes: The woodcut is not text. The heading line and the lower text are cut off at the right edge of this part, so words there are incomplete. Printed words in brackets are cut off by the scan edge. Part 2 of a page; the left part of the running head reads "...ustatis." (partly cut off). The running head reads "...I C I Marini ex Oceano," with the left part cut. The caption line is cut at its left end; the visible text is "n xii. pedum, qui devoratur à monstro marino" and "rà inter Cete ex Tabula Olai." The lower caption line is partly cut off at the left and is transcribed only as visible. Two woodcut illustrations are present; no text in them.
